      body:
        contentId: "test-content"

        json_schema:

            version: { type: number }

    verification:
      type: http
      method: PUT

        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
        If-Match: "{etag}"
      body:
        contentId: "updated-content"
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: object

            version: { type: number }
